fixes.change: Generation and disposal guards; stale completions do not commit or notify.
Pause the old source before installing the selection; resume only a valid dry or processed state with current playback intent.
Refresh downstream routing without recreating the source or modifying the cue/start clock.
Snap only within a bounded floating-point tolerance before ceil/floor; preserve real fractional boundaries and length caps.
Retain the monitoring graph for a non-default matrix or non-bypass band selection and refresh it on setting changes.
Snapshot source identities, revisions, buffers and operation dependencies; validate before commit and use the common error/finally path for cancellation.
Use Uri.joinPath on the source URI rather than reconstructing a local file URI from fsPath.
